Further, the power to relax is to be exercised only when undue hardship is caused by the application of the rules or regulations. In the present case, the Petitioner is a transmission licensee who is already implementing the project defined under its scope through the TBCB mechanism. The present Petition is consequent to the office order 9.3.2022 notified by the Ministry of Power, Government of India, wherein NCT is the approving authority for upgradation/modification of existing ISTS communication schemes.
